comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. The period in milliseconds is 500 + x*475 in one switch position and 3000 + x*2500 in the other, plus five milliseconds per unit of the fine knob, where x is a logistic curve of the coarse knob offset by the TIME CV. The counter that the divisions are taken from advances twice per printed beat, so the divisors in the code are twice the numbers on the panel. The divisions the code selects are 4, 8, 12, 16 and 6, 10, 14, 18 in the two rows, multiplied by four in the right-hand column, which matches the panel's 2, 4, 6, 8 / 3, 5, 7, 9 and 8, 16, 24, 32 / 12, 20, 28, 36.
